name: Nine Dragons and Nine Phoenix Crown
description: The empress of Ming Xiao Duanxian, Sister Wang Xi, worked hard for the world and silently sacrificed her life for the people throughout her life. Her virtues were praised by the world. Emperor Shenzong of the Suiming Dynasty made a crown for her with the highest honor of Nine Dragons and Nine Phoenixes. The nine dragons and nine phoenixes face all directions and the sea, symbolizing blessings for the common people; the dragons and phoenixes are aligned to show that the sun and moon shine together, and they are virtuous and respected; the jade beads and flowers complement each other, recording the footprints of benefiting the people. Those who win this crown will calm the hearts of the people in the world.
